response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component BSK_BT_PBMCCytotoxicity was analyzed at the endpoint, BSK_BT_PBMCCytotoxicity, in the positive analysis fitting direction relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of viability reporter, gain or loss-of-signal activity can be used to understand cellular changes in viability. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the 'cell cycle' intended target family, where the subfamily is 'cytotoxicity'.
response.assayComponentDesc: BSK_BT_PBMCCytotoxicity is an assay component measured in the BSK_BT assay. It measures dehydrogenase activity, a form of viability reporter, as detected with fluorescence intensity signals by Alamar Blue Reduction technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: PBMC Cytotoxicity in the BT system is a measure of the cell death of PBMC. Cell viability of non-adherent cells is measured by Alamar Blue staining, a method based on a cell permeable compound that emits fluorescence after entering cells. The number of living cells is proportional to the amount of fluorescence produced
